title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.74
summary: Autonomer Linux-Kiosk mit sicherer, dauerhafter, widerrufbarer Geraetesitzung und automatischem Wiederverbinden.
changes: Support secure revocable HttpOnly Linux device grants and automatic JWT refresh
Enable Electron fullscreen kiosk, single-instance and resilient backoff reconnect
Install Linux desktop autostart without root or weakening sandbox
Rebuild downloadable Linux x64 ZIP with updated application code
Preserve web authentication, recording, motion, 26-camera bootstrap and stable broker
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.74
description: Refreshable revocable device grants, Electron kiosk reconnect/autostart and rebuilt Linux desktop download ZIP.
releaseNotes: Dedicated Linux Kiosk client now auto-starts in fullscreen at Linux user login (configurable), recovers after server/network outage and retains a securely renewable opt-in device session. Server stores only SHA256 hashes of revocable 90-day idle device grants; temporary 8h JWT access tokens are refreshed every 15 minutes. Explicit signout revokes grant, changes in user password/role disable old sessions, no TLS bypass, no auto login without explicit device consent. Updated downloadable Linux ZIP. Existing streams, recordings, motion, 2.20.73 layout editor and go2rtc stable.
